description: Source code for xutils.c, part of the LibXDiff library, implementing utility functions such as square root approximation, diff record emission, memory file handling, and line processing.

methods.name: xdl_bogosqrt
methods.description: Approximates the integer square root of a number using bit shifts.

methods.name: xdl_emit_diffrec
methods.description: Emits a diff record, handling line endings and invoking callback.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_first
methods.description: Returns pointer to the first data in a memory-mapped file and its size.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory-mapped file.

methods.name: xdl_cha_init
methods.description: Initializes a circular buffer (chastore_t) with given element size and count.

methods.name: xdl_cha_free
methods.description: Frees all nodes in a chastore_t linked list.

methods.name: xdl_cha_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new node in the chastore_t, expanding if necessary.

methods.name: xdl_guess_lines
methods.description: Estimates the number of lines in a memory file based on sample lines.

methods.name: xdl_blankline
methods.description: Checks if a line is blank or whitespace-only based on flags.

methods.name: ends_with_optional_cr
methods.description: Checks if a line ends with an optional carriage return before newline.

methods.name: xdl_recmatch
methods.description: Compares two lines with various whitespace and CR ignoring options.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace
methods.description: Computes a hash of a record, ignoring whitespace based on flags.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_verbatim
methods.description: Computes a hash of a record verbatim, processing two characters at a time.

methods.name: xdl_hashbits
methods.description: Calculates the number of bits needed for a hash table of given size.

methods.name: xdl_num_out
methods.description: Converts a long integer to string representation.

methods.name: xdl_format_hunk_hdr
methods.description: Formats a diff hunk header line.

methods.name: xdl_emit_hunk_hdr
methods.description: Emits a diff hunk header, either formatted or via callback.

methods.name: xdl_fall_back_diff
methods.description: Performs a fallback diff on file segments outside of main diff engine.

methods.name: xdl_alloc_grow_helper
methods.description: Helper to grow an allocated buffer with size checks.
